product_one_liner.value: Vim provides an AI-powered healthcare workflow and integration platform that connects EHRs, payers, providers, and health-tech applications, helping healthcare organizations put data and AI agents to work in clinical workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as healthcare infrastructure and an AI operating system connecting healthcare systems, data, and teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage’s navigation and footer do not link to a public pricing page; the company directs prospective customers to contact its sales team.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in Vim customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 419 employees as of September 30, 2026, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile identifies New York, NY, as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Vim’s company profile identifies 2015 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes engineering-authored technical material: an AppSec engineer’s post on secure coding practices and an infrastructure case study on Vim’s artifact distribution and Amazon S3 egress costs.

public_docs.notes: Vim has a public developer documentation portal with multiple sections, including platform, SDK, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The linked Greenhouse board reported no open job positions; no AI/ML/data-science role is listed.

model_provider.notes: Vim’s public documentation, blog, Trust Center, and privacy materials reviewed did not identify a specific AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center says Vim is HITRUST CSF certified, SOC 2 Type II audited, and HIPAA-compliant.

last_funding.notes: The 2021 financing completed the $60 million round; the funding profile identifies the latest round as Series C in May 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round identified is the May 2021 Series C; no later round is shown, so Vim did not raise within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Vim’s current careers link leads to a board reporting no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and newsroom show no product or major-feature launch dated May 9, 2026 or later. The latest identified launch announcement was Care Insights in January 2025.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full leadership roster was reviewed; it provides no indication of a C-level or VP-level appointment within the 12 months before November 9, 2026, and the newsroom shows no relevant departure announcement.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Vim’s public developer documentation and linked job board were readable and did not name CRM or sales/marketing systems.
